message:
I've learned the hard way that storms can knock out power and leave us scrambling. One minute you’re cozy in your home, and the next, your phone’s battery is gasping for breath, and it feels like you’re cut off from the world. That’s why I like to keep a few old-school resources handy, like printed lists of emergency contacts and tips. You know, just in case my phone decides to take an unexpected nap. 

What’s your go-to tip for staying prepared when the weather turns? ☁️
